Looking for alternatives to the Chronic Hookah Instant Lights
Hey, /r/hookah!

I got hooked on the Chronic Hookah Instant Lights last year, as I usually smoke outside or places where I don't have access to electric burners.

I haven't smoked in a while, and realized that I'm out of coals, so I went to re-stock my stash of CH instants, only to realize that they seem to have been discontinued.

My questions to you:

1. Has anyone heard whether or not the CH instants are coming back, or are they gone forever?
2. Are there any instant lights that would be a good alternative to the CH instants?

I've used three kings before, and I don't mind them, but I've been smoking more tangiers than anything else lately, and I've never been able to get an enjoyable session out of three kings (heat management is a bitch with these, unless I cut them in half). I've had consistent success only with CH instants and natural coals.

If good alternatives aren't available, I may have to invest in a portable gas burner and some coco naras.

Thanks in advance for your help!
